pages.title: Star Light Zone
pages.text: Star Light Zone is the fifth level of Sonic the Hedgehog (Sega, 1991). Its theme came back in 2021, when a remix of it was used in the opening ceremony of the Tokyo Olympics, the games of 2020 that were held a year late.

pages.title: Four sounds at once
pages.text: Masato Nakamura, who wrote the music of Sonic the Hedgehog, said in a Sega interview that his tools gave him only four sounds at the same time. He called it a limit, and he still wrote tunes that people hummed along to, which was his aim from the start.
